summary: Move/resize a window using partial Rectangle semantics.

target.notes: Requires an ElectronCompat native-window abstraction so object lifetime and window events remain observable.

caveats: A direct assignment of a full Rectangle is wrong when the source passes only one property.
Wayland global coordinates can be unavailable; macOS may clamp y below menu/tray area.

tests.name: partial width update
tests.expected_behavior: only width changes; current x, y and height are preserved

tests.name: platform coordinate clamp
tests.expected_behavior: reported bounds may be OS-adjusted; do not assume byte-for-byte equality with requested coordinates
